source.identityLimitation: The installed canonical collection has no available Git revision. The original observed aggregate is retained; the enforceable aggregate and per-tree SHA-256 digests normalize regular-file permissions to Git-portable 0644/0755 semantics.

treeDigestAlgorithm: sha256(canonical-json(sorted relative entries)); regular file mode normalized to Git-portable 0644 or 0755; allowed overlays excluded and hashed separately

docs-writer.scope: Public-copy wording only after docs-maintainer selects the semantic owner; never maintenance, lifecycle, generated content, package docs, runbooks, proof, impact-ledger, or validation ownership.

portless.scope: Existing local development routing only; excluded from canonical harness-baseline claims.

cleanCloneRule: Validation reads only repository-relative .agents, .claude, tools, and docs paths; it must not read a user home or installed global collection.
reviewTrigger: Intentional canonical skill refresh, repository-profile change, extra-skill ownership change, Claude-link change, validator change, or repository path-portability failure.
retirementCondition: Retire this receipt only when a successor content-addressed baseline and migration receipt are accepted together.
limitations: The receipt binds the canonical source observed on 2026-07-24 and does not claim compatibility with future source trees.
The two repository-profile overlays are excluded from baseline tree comparison and are independently hashed.
The source collection contained host-specific non-executable permissions that Git cannot retain; receipt modes intentionally preserve only Git's executable-bit distinction.
nonClaims: No global skill installation is required or qualified at repository runtime.
The receipt does not establish package behavior, hosted CI, remote Git, registry, release, deployment, provider, production, public-site, or external-consumer state.
